english: The Crown has requested an additional supply of feathers and wool to help make bedding and blankets for those in need.
french: La Couronne demande une livraison supplémentaire de plumes et de laine afin de confectionner du linge de lit et des couvertures pour les nécessiteux.
russian: Корона запросила дополнительную поставку перьев и шерсти, чтобы изготовить постельные принадлежности и одеяла для нуждающихся.
bulgarian: The Crown has requested an additional supply of feathers and wool to help make bedding and blankets for those in need.

english: Crown Request: Animal Materials
french: Requête royale : matières animales
bulgarian: Crown Request: Animal Materials

english: Ship 10 feathers and 10 wool of any kind, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 10 plumes et 10 écheveaux de laine de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 10 перьев и 10 шерсти любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 10 feathers and 10 wool of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: The Capital Museum has requested local artifact shards from all around Aldaria as it conducts a research project.
french: Le musée de la capitale cherche à récupérer des éclats d'artéfacts issus de tout Aldaria pour mener à bien un projet de recherche.
russian: Столичный музей запросил осколки местных артефактов со всей Альдарии для исследовательского проекта.
bulgarian: The Capital Museum has requested local artifact shards from all around Aldaria as it conducts a research project.

english: Crown Request: Archaeology Shards
french: Requête royale : éclats archéologiques
bulgarian: Crown Request: Archaeology Shards

english: Ship 15 Shards and 5 Shard Masses, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 15 éclats et 5 agglomérats, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 15 осколков и 5 комков из осколков, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 15 Shards and 5 Shard Masses, then talk to Adeline.

english: The Crown has put out a request for hearty main dishes to be shipped out to villages in the Western Mountains of Aldaria, to help offset a poor harvest in the region.
french: La Couronne a besoin de plats principaux roboratifs, cuits au four, pour les expédier dans les villages de montagne situés à l'ouest d'Aldaria afin de compenser les mauvaises récoltes dans cette région.
russian: Короне требуются сытные основные блюда для отправки в деревни в Западных горах Альдарии, чтобы компенсировать плохой урожай в этом регионе.
bulgarian: The Crown has put out a request for hearty main dishes to be shipped out to villages in the Western Mountains of Aldaria, to help offset a poor harvest in the region.

english: Crown Request: Baked Main Dishes
french: Requête royale : plats principaux (au four)
bulgarian: Crown Request: Baked Main Dishes

english: Ship 5 Baked Main Dishes of any kind, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 5 plats principaux cuits au four, de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить любые 5 печёных основных блюд, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 5 Baked Main Dishes of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: The Crown believes it is important to assess the emerging specialities of its towns for export potential, and Bell Berries are one of Mistria's.
french: La Couronne estime qu'il est important de mesurer le potentiel d'exportation des nouvelles spécialités produites dans ses villes. Les clocherelles de Mistria en sont une.
russian: Корона считает важным оценить экспортный потенциал фирменных блюд, зарождающихся в городах. Ягоды колокольника — характерный пример мистрийского блюда.
bulgarian: The Crown believes it is important to assess the emerging specialities of its towns for export potential, and Bell Berries are one of Mistria's.

english: Crown Request: Bell Berries
french: Requête royale : clocherelles
bulgarian: Crown Request: Bell Berries

english: Ship 20 Bell Berries, then report to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 20 clocherelles, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 20 ягод колокольника, затем доложить Аделине.
bulgarian: Ship 20 Bell Berries, then report to Adeline.

english: The Capital Market has put out a request for fresh berries. They're always in high demand!\n\nI know it doesn't seem like much, but shipping out some berries would be a big help.
french: Le marché de la capitale a besoin de baies fraîches. Elles sont toujours très demandées !\n\nJe sais que ça n'a l'air de rien, mais cela les aiderait beaucoup si nous envoyions quelques baies.
russian: Столичный рынок запросил свежие ягоды. На них всегда высокий спрос!\n\nЗнаю, звучит как не очень много, но эти ягоды очень помогут.
bulgarian: The Capital Market has put out a request for fresh berries. They're always in high demand!\n\nI know it doesn't seem like much, but shipping out some berries would be a big help.

english: Crown Request: Berries
french: Requête royale : baies
bulgarian: Crown Request: Berries

english: Ship 30 berries of any kind, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 30 baies de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить любые 30 ягод, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 30 berries of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: An increase in the number of farms being established across rural Aldaria has meant that copper tools are in high demand.\n\nShipping some out would help support these newer farms.
french: Le nombre de fermes qui s'installent dans les régions rurales d'Aldaria est en augmentation et la demande d'outils en cuivre est par conséquent très importante.\n\nEn expédier quelques-uns marquerait notre soutien aux nouvelles installations.
russian: Рост числа ферм в сельской Альдарии привёл к высокому спросу на медные инструменты.\n\nОтправив им партию наших, мы поможем поддержать новые фермы.
bulgarian: An increase in the number of farms being established across rural Aldaria has meant that copper tools are in high demand.\n\nShipping some out would help support these newer farms.

english: Crown Request: Copper Tools
french: Requête royale : outils en cuivre
bulgarian: Crown Request: Copper Tools

english: Ship any 5 Copper Tools, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 5 outils en cuivre et parlez à Adeline.
russian: Отправить любые 5 медных инструментов, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship any 5 Copper Tools, then talk to Adeline.

english: Not every place in Aldaria is as bountiful as Mistria, and fresh crops would go a long way to help out areas that are still struggling to recover after the earthquake.
french: La terre n'est pas aussi généreuse dans toutes les régions d'Aldaria qu'elle l'est à Mistria. Partager nos récoltes serait d'une grande aide pour ces zones, qui peinent encore à se remettre du tremblement de terre.
russian: Не везде в Альдарии такое изобилие, как в Мистрии. Свежие растительные плоды очень помогут другим регионам, которые ещё восстанавливаются после землетрясения.
bulgarian: Not every place in Aldaria is as bountiful as Mistria, and fresh crops would go a long way to help out areas that are still struggling to recover after the earthquake.

english: Crown Request: Crops
french: Requête royale : récoltes
bulgarian: Crown Request: Crops

english: Ship 30 crops of any kind, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 30 produits de récolte de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 30 плодов любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 30 crops of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: Bad weather up the coast has kept fishing boats from sailing out. Shipments of fish would go a long way to help until the storms clear up.
french: Le mauvais temps sur la côte plus au nord empêche les bateaux de prendre la mer. L'expédition de poisson les aiderait beaucoup, en attendant que les tempêtes se calment.
russian: Плохая погода на побережье не даёт рыбакам выйти в море. Поставки рыбы очень помогут переждать, когда утихнут штормы.
bulgarian: Bad weather up the coast has kept fishing boats from sailing out. Shipments of fish would go a long way to help until the storms clear up.

english: Crown Request: Fish
french: Requête royale : poisson
bulgarian: Crown Request: Fish

english: Ship 40 fish of any kind, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 40 poissons de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 40 рыб любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 40 fish of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: Princess Delaphine has heard that there are no finer flowers in Aldaria than in Mistria!\n\nThis is a special request to help supply the floral arrangements for her birthday celebration.
french: La princesse Delaphine a entendu dire que les plus belles fleurs d'Aldaria se trouvaient à Mistria !\n\nIl s'agit d'une requête spéciale, afin de participer aux compositions florales destinées à sa fête d'anniversaire.
russian: Принцессе Делафине рассказали, что в Альдарии нет цветов красивее, чем у нас в Мистрии!\n\nЭто особый запрос для цветочных композиций ко дню её рождения.
bulgarian: Princess Delaphine has heard that there are no finer flowers in Aldaria than in Mistria!\n\nThis is a special request to help supply the floral arrangements for her birthday celebration.

english: Crown Request: Flowers
french: Requête royale : fleurs
bulgarian: Crown Request: Flowers

english: Ship any 30 Flowers, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 30 fleurs de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 30 любых цветов, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship any 30 Flowers, then talk to Adeline.

english: The Crown is searching for new sources of gold within Aldaria.
french: La Couronne cherche de nouvelles sources d'approvisionnement en or sur Aldaria.
russian: Корона ищет новые источники золота в Альдарии.
bulgarian: The Crown is searching for new sources of gold within Aldaria.

english: Crown Request: Gold Ingots
french: Requête royale : lingots d'or
bulgarian: Crown Request: Gold Ingots

english: Ship 10 Gold Ingots, then report to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 10 lingots d'or, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 10 золотых слитков, затем доложить Аделине.
bulgarian: Ship 10 Gold Ingots, then report to Adeline.

english: There's no better way to show foreign dignitaries that Aldaria is back on its feet than to give them a meal made with all Aldarian ingredients!\n\nBut to do that, chefs in the Capital will need the very best.
french: Il n'y a pas de meilleur moyen pour prouver aux dignitaires étrangers qu'Aldaria s'est rétablie que de leur offrir un repas préparé avec tous les ingrédients du royaume !\n\nMais pour ça, les chefs, dans la capitale, auront besoin de ce qui se fait de mieux.
russian: Лучший способ показать иностранным гостям, что Альдария оправилась от беды — угостить их блюдами из местных ингредиентов!\n\nНо для этого столичным поварам нужны отборные продукты.
bulgarian: There's no better way to show foreign dignitaries that Aldaria is back on its feet than to give them a meal made with all Aldarian ingredients!\n\nBut to do that, chefs in the Capital will need the very best.

english: Crown Request: Golden Ingredients
french: Requête royale : ingrédients dorés
bulgarian: Crown Request: Golden Ingredients

english: Ship 5 Golden Cheese and 5 Golden Mayonnaise of any kind, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 5 fromages dorés et 5 mayonnaises dorées de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 5 золотых сыров и 5 золотых майонезов любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 5 Golden Cheese and 5 Golden Mayonnaise of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: Grass Starters are needed to help combat topsoil erosion along the edge of the badlands.
french: L'herbe à pâturage est utile pour lutter contre l'érosion du sol en bordure des terres infertiles.
russian: Рассада травы нужна, чтобы бороться с эрозией почвы на окраинах пустошей.
bulgarian: Grass Starters are needed to help combat topsoil erosion along the edge of the badlands.

english: Crown Request: Grass Starters
french: Requête royale : herbe à pâturage
bulgarian: Crown Request: Grass Starters

english: Ship 10 Grass Starters, then report to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 10 touffes d'herbe à pâturage, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 10 рассады травы, затем доложить Аделине.
bulgarian: Ship 10 Grass Starters, then report to Adeline.

english: Quality metal ingots are vital for work all over Aldaria, but supply simply hasn't kept up with demand.\n\nShipping ingots would help projects that have stalled out.
french: Les lingots de métal de qualité sont indispensables pour travailler, partout dans Aldaria, mais la demande est supérieure à l'offre.\n\nL'expédition de lingots permettrait de relancer des projets mis à l'arrêt.
russian: Качественные металлические слитки необходимы для работ по всей Альдарии, но спрос обгоняет предложение.\n\nПоставки слитков помогут возобновить остановившиеся проекты.
bulgarian: Quality metal ingots are vital for work all over Aldaria, but supply simply hasn't kept up with demand.\n\nShipping ingots would help projects that have stalled out.

english: Crown Request: Ingots
french: Requête royale : lingots
bulgarian: Crown Request: Ingots

english: Ship 10 Iron Ingots and 5 Silver Ingots, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 10 lingots de fer et 5 lingots d'argent, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 10 железных слитков и 5 серебряных слитков, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 10 Iron Ingots and 5 Silver Ingots, then talk to Adeline.

english: The Royal Physician is requesting rare and unusual underground materials to see if any would be useful to his work.
french: Le médecin royal demande des objets souterrains rares et inhabituels, afin de voir s'ils pourraient être utiles à sa pratique.
russian: Королевский лекарь просит редкие и необычные материалы из подземелий, чтобы оценить их эффективность в его работе.
bulgarian: The Royal Physician is requesting rare and unusual underground materials to see if any would be useful to his work.

english: Crown Request: Mine Forageables
french: Requête royale : objets des mines
bulgarian: Crown Request: Mine Forageables

english: Ship 30 forageables from the Mines, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 30 objets récupérés dans les mines, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 30 находок из шахт, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 30 forageables from the Mines, then talk to Adeline.

english: Linsberry Island has been reporting the appearance of unusually aggressive wildlife that the Capital has no previous record of.\n\nThey're issuing a call to see if anyone has physical examples of something similar in the kingdom.
french: L'île de Linsbaie a rapporté l'apparition d'une faune anormalement agressive, ce qui n'avait encore jamais été documenté à la capitale.\n\nUn appel est donc lancé pour savoir si certaines personnes posséderaient des exemples concrets de phénomènes similaires ailleurs dans le royaume.
russian: Остров Линсберри сообщает о появлении необычно агрессивной дикой фауны. В столичных архивах о ней ничего нет.\n\nОни ищут физические образцы чего-то подобного из королевства.
bulgarian: Linsberry Island has been reporting the appearance of unusually aggressive wildlife that the Capital has no previous record of.\n\nThey're issuing a call to see if anyone has physical examples of something similar in the kingdom.

english: Crown Request: Monster Materials
french: Requête royale : matières monstrueuses
bulgarian: Crown Request: Monster Materials

english: Ship any 30 Monster Drops, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 30 objets abandonnés par des monstres, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 30 материалов монстров любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship any 30 Monster Drops, then talk to Adeline.

english: Shipments of Refined Stone from Mistria would help to provide high quality materials for various building projects across the kingdom.
french: L'expédition de pierre affinée issue de Mistria permettrait de fournir des matériaux de grande qualité destinés à divers projets de construction dans tout le royaume.
russian: Поставки плиточного камня из Мистрии помогут предоставить качественные материалы для различных строительных проектов по всему королевству.
bulgarian: Shipments of Refined Stone from Mistria would help to provide high quality materials for various building projects across the kingdom.

english: Crown Request: Refined Stone
french: Requête royale : pierre affinée
bulgarian: Crown Request: Refined Stone

english: Ship 20 Refined Stone, then report to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 20 pierres affinées, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 20 штук плиточного камня, затем доложить Аделине.
bulgarian: Ship 20 Refined Stone, then report to Adeline.

english: The Capital's soup kitchen has requested regional soups to help replenish its larder.
french: La soupe populaire de la capitale aimerait recevoir des soupes régionales afin de l'aider à remplir son garde-manger.
russian: Столичная столовая для бедных запрашивает региональные супы, чтобы пополнить свои запасы.
bulgarian: The Capital's soup kitchen has requested regional soups to help replenish its larder.

english: Crown Request: Soup
french: Requête royale : soupe
bulgarian: Crown Request: Soup

english: Ship 15 soups of any kind, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 15 soupes de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 15 супов любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 15 soups of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: An old stone retaining wall recently collapsed along a well traveled road in the northeast.\n\nThe surveyors want to build it back even better, so as much stone as can be spared is requested.
french: Un vieux mur de soutènement en pierre s'est récemment effondré le long d'une route très fréquentée du nord-est.\n\nLes géomètres veulent le reconstruire plus solidement et demandent qu'on leur fournisse autant de pierres que possible.
russian: Недавно на оживлённой дороге на северо-востоке обрушилась старая подпорная стена.\n\nСтроители хотят построить новую — крепче прежней. Так что требуется как можно больше камня.
bulgarian: An old stone retaining wall recently collapsed along a well traveled road in the northeast.\n\nThe surveyors want to build it back even better, so as much stone as can be spared is requested.

english: Crown Request: Stone
french: Requête royale : pierre
bulgarian: Crown Request: Stone

english: Ship 250 stone, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 250 pierres, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 250 камня, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 250 stone, then talk to Adeline.

english: Repairs and upgrades to the roads of Aldaria is an ongoing task. Additional paving materials would help to speed up the work!
french: Les routes d'Aldaria sont en train d'être réparées et améliorées. Des pavés supplémentaires permettraient d'accélérer le travail !
russian: Продолжается ремонт и улучшение альдарийских дорог. Дополнительные материалы для мощения помогут ускорить работу!
bulgarian: Repairs and upgrades to the roads of Aldaria is an ongoing task. Additional paving materials would help to speed up the work!

english: Crown Request: Stone Paths
french: Requête royale : pavés
bulgarian: Crown Request: Stone Paths

english: Ship any 100 Stone Paths, then talk to Adeline.
french: Expédiez 100 pavés de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 100 каменных дорожек любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship any 100 Stone Paths, then talk to Adeline.

english: The Capital is constructing a brand new orphanage, but has run into issues with not having enough woodworkers available.\n\nHelp supply new furniture so the children can be moved into their new home as quickly as possible.
french: La capitale construit un orphelinat flambant neuf, mais rencontre des difficultés car les menuisiers disponibles manquent.\n\nLa fourniture de nouveaux meubles permettra aux enfants d'aménager au plus vite dans leur nouveau foyer.
russian: В столице строится новый приют для сирот, но возникла проблема с нехваткой столяров.\n\nПомогите поставить мебель, чтобы дети как можно скорее могли переехать в новый дом.
bulgarian: The Capital is constructing a brand new orphanage, but has run into issues with not having enough woodworkers available.\n\nHelp supply new furniture so the children can be moved into their new home as quickly as possible.

french: Requête royale : tables et chaises
bulgarian: Crown Request: Tables and Chairs

french: Expédiez 6 tables de salle à manger et 12 chaises de n'importe quelle sorte, puis allez parler à Adeline.
russian: Отправить 6 обеденных столов и 12 стульев любого вида, затем поговорить с Аделиной.
bulgarian: Ship 6 Dining Tables and 12 Dining Chairs of any kind, then talk to Adeline.

english: When the earthquake hit, we lost a lot of our gear in the Mines.\n\nI found my pickaxe, but Errol never found his. I'd love to return it to him!
french: Lors du tremblement de terre, nous avons perdu beaucoup d'équipement dans les mines.\n\nJ'ai retrouvé ma pioche, mais Errol n'a jamais remis la main sur la sienne. J'adorerais la lui rapporter !
russian: Когда произошло землетрясение, мы потеряли много снаряжения в шахтах.\n\nЯ нашёл свою кирку, но Эррол так и не нашёл свою. Я бы хотел вернуть её ему!
bulgarian: When the earthquake hit, we lost a lot of our gear in the Mines.\n\nI found my pickaxe, but Errol never found his. I'd love to return it to him!

english: Request for a Miner's Pickaxe
french: Besoin d'une pioche de mineur
bulgarian: Request for a Miner's Pickaxe

english: Bring a Miner's Pickaxe to Olric.
french: Apportez une pioche de mineur à Olric.
bulgarian: Bring a Miner's Pickaxe to Olric.

english: I require a red toadstool for something I'm working on. I will not be elaborating.
french: Il me faut une amanite tue-mouches pour un truc sur lequel je travaille. Je ne vais pas entrer dans les détails.
russian: Мне нужен красный мухомор для одного дела. Подробностей не будет.
bulgarian: I require a red toadstool for something I'm working on. I will not be elaborating.

english: Request for a Red Toadstool
french: Besoin d'une amanite tue-mouches
bulgarian: Request for a Red Toadstool

english: Bring a red toadstool to Juniper.
french: Apportez une amanite tue-mouches à Juniper.
bulgarian: Bring a red toadstool to Juniper.

russian: К сожалению, в моём огороде повадились завтракать наглые птицы. Могу я попросить пугало, чтобы сохранить мои овощи?

bulgarian: The Codex Mistria has some very interesting flowers it says are native to the region including a "Shadow Flower".\n\nI'd like to have one to see how it grows!
